title: What’s your favorite / least favorite runtime?? 👀 #theatre #film #bro...
transcript: every piece of media should be either under 2 hours or over 3 hours that's my little hot take rule of thumb that I like to say but let me explain what I mean by it first of all technically this can apply to any storytelling medium but it mostly has to do with film and theatre cause they're the ones that straddle that line and like it's kind of a joke? like it's a joke in the sense that obviously I've seen many many films and plays and musicals and whatever that are somewhere between 2 and 3 hours but they are brilliant and they are exactly the length that they needed to be artistically but there's two angles from which I guess I mean it more genuinely first of all it's kind of a hyperbolic way of pointing out a trend where a lot of media can feel very padded out or bloated especially when it comes to big blockbuster movies or big musicals on Broadway and sometimes I have the feeling of like “this could have been under two hours and achieved the same goal” meanwhile if something is over three hours it's often because it really needed to be for the artist to create the effect that they wanted that's obviously a massive over-generalization but that is a trend I would say but the other way which is not really a joke or hyperbole to me at all is that it's how I genuinely react when I look up the runtime it has to do with how the viewing experience fits into my daily life if it's under two hours I'm like great I'm gonna be in and out and still have time to get home early or go out afterwards or if I'm watching it at home it's like, I have time to get to other things like it's not my whole evening and then if it's over three hours like now it's an Experience with a capital E it's an investment it's the Marathon mentality like now the runtime is part of the fun But if I look up the runtime and it's two and a half hours then I just say ugh alright like this feels like it's gonna be long in more of a (derogatory) way
classificationReason: General hot take / commentary about ideal runtime for film and theatre broadly — no specific stage production reviewed or discussed.
